question: What is the amount of financial assistance provided per month to girl students studying in government schools under the 'Tamil Nadu Pudhumi Penn Scheme' launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1,000 per month**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tamil Nadu Pudhumi Penn Scheme was launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu in 2023.
 
• It aims to provide financial assistance specifically to girl students studying in government schools.
 
• Under this scheme, each girl student receives ₹1,000 per month as financial aid.
 
• The scheme is part of the government's initiative to promote education among girl children and reduce drop-out rates in schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Educational Financial Assistance Schemes in India**

 
 
• **Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme:** This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Class IX and X to reduce the drop-out rate and promote secondary education.
 
• **Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme:** This scheme aims to provide financial support to students from economically weaker sections after they have completed their matriculation so that they can pursue higher education.
 
• **National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme:** It aims to provide scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to prevent their drop-out at Class VIII and encourage them to continue their education at the secondary stage.
 
• **Maulana Azad National Scholarship Scheme:** This scheme is specifically for meritorious girls belonging to minority communities to provide financial assistance for their higher education.
 
 
 
• **Social Initiatives for Girl Child Education**
 
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao:** Launched by the Government of India, this scheme aims to ensure the survival, protection, and education of the girl child.
 
• **Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana:** A savings scheme initiated for the girl child, it encourages parents to build a fund for the future education and marriage expenses of their girl child.
 
• **Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya:** This scheme aims to provide residential schools at the upper primary level for girls belonging to SC, ST, OBC, minority communities, and BPL families.
 
• **CBSE Udaan:** It aims to address the low enrollment ratio of girl students in prestigious engineering institutions and provides free online resources for preparation for engineering entrance exams.
